blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University caught La Salle—and the rest of the league—off guard with its 90-78 win on Wednesday in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena. The Tamaraws dragged the defending champions to a lopsided game from start to finish, with five players scoring in double figures. “We got in the gym, we got better, we pushed each other and sometimes, pain becomes one of your greatest teachers,” said FEU coach Sean Chambers. “It felt like we just prepared for it after [playing against] UE, […]...
